Automation Opportunity: - Credit-score auto-computed from the financial-data feed; credit-limit auto-suggested from the scoring model; collection-aging auto-tracked with escalation
Controls: - CTL-434 (credit-authorization — links to VS-16 / W24); Operational: Credit Analyst sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Credit-default risk**: a trade account defaults on extended credit, creating a bad-debt write-off; mitigated by the credit-scoring model and the credit-limit monitoring

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit

- Mobile app (links to VS-75 / digital engagement app, VS-10 / ecommerce)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Credit Analyst role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

fields.Participants: Collections Specialist, Credit Analyst, Finance Mgr

Automation Opportunity: - Process steps auto-sequenced with system controls; data-entry auto-populated from master data; exceptions auto-flagged for human review
Controls: - CTL-212: duplicate-invoice/payment-application guard; Operational: Collections Specialist sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Execution risk**: process variability or system failure disrupts the workflow's output; mitigated by the documented procedure and the system controls

- **Score-distortion risk**: the payment-behavior score is gamed or stale (lump-sum payments inflating on-time %, disputed invoices distorting days-past-due), mispricing credit limits; mitigated by the monthly refresh, trend-based inputs, and Credit Analyst review of composite risk-score outliers
System Touchpoints: - Pricing/financials (links to VS-17 / W9 financial close, VS-29 / W289 pricing master)
Time Estimate: - Volume: ~260–416 past-due accounts at any time
- Frequency: Daily monitoring; ~5–8% of accounts typically past due
- Absorbed into the Collections Specialist role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: System generates daily past-due report: aging buckets (30/60/90/120+ days); Collections Specialist contacts customers: 30-day (friendly reminder), 60-day (formal demand), 90-day (hold shipments), 120+ day (legal escalation)
